newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - December 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - December 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Crown Prince Abdullah calls for united Gulf Arab stand.
- China's trade exhibition ended in Jeddah with $17.8 million in deals signed.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines to start non-stop flights to Cairo from Dhahran from December 18.
- SABIC chairman says Saudi Arabia exports to China in 1995 were worth 450 million riyals.
- Up to 16 investment opportunities worth two billion riyals to be announced at an industrial investment seminar in Dammam.
- Chairman of the industrial committee at the eastern province chamber of commerce says a new company will be set up to develop national exports.
